summary: John's 2nd-great-grand-uncle; associate editor of the Sunday Independent.
bio:
John Vincent Heffernan (9 Jul 1886 - 1 Mar 1958), associate editor of the Sunday Independent; married Edith Corrine Graham in New York City in 1914; died at Alexandria, Virginia.

FamilySearch gives the marriage as 4 May 1914 in Manhattan and his wife as Edith Corrine Grammes (1896-1938), daughter of Cyrus Randolph Gramm(es) and Martha L. Robinson; she died at Wilkes-Barre on 6 Nov 1938 and is buried at Fairview Cemetery, Danville. Their daughter was Mary Louise Heffernan (1921-2011) ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]).
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
Harvey & Smith, A History of Wilkes-Barre, vol. VI p.460: https://archive.org/details/historyofwilkesb06harv/page/460/mode/1up
